# Need to do some work on the df to input phylogenetic information

Run an initial Mice run with 5 iterations

```r
```r

# Initialize mice current example is 
imp2 <- mice(Marsimp, maxit=5, print = FALSE, seed = 123)

stripplot(imp2, dentary ~.imp)

# Extract complete imputed data

imp2.dat <- complete(imp2, action = \long\)

# Collect Mean values and Variance on the Mean of all variables
MEAN <- tapply(imp2.dat$dentary, imp2.dat$.imp, mean)
VAR.MEAN <- tapply(imp2.dat$dentary, imp2.dat$.imp, var)/nrow(imp2$data)

cbind(\MEAN\ = MEAN, \VAR.MEAN\ = VAR.MEAN)

#Plot Mean and Variance of Mean for an example variable, in this case Articular Width
par(mfrow = c(1,2))
plot(MEAN ~ I(1:imp2$m), ylab= \Mean\, xlab = \Imputation\, main = \Mean \nby imputation\)
abline(h=mean(MEAN), col = \red\, lty = 2, lwd=2)

plot(VAR.MEAN~I(1:imp2$m), ylab= \Variance of Mean\, xlab = \Imputation\, main = \Variance of Mean\nby imputation\)
abline(h=mean(VAR.MEAN), col = \red\, lty = 2, lwd=2)

# Pool the means and variance of the means
POOLED <- pool.scalar(MEAN, VAR.MEAN, nrow(imp2$data))

data.frame(pooled.mean = mean(MEAN), mean.var = mean(VAR.MEAN), btw.var = var(MEAN), pooled.var = mean(VAR.MEAN) + (1+1/length(MEAN))*var(MEAN))

mars_tree <- read.tree("newtree.nwk")
plot(mars_tree)
Mars_Avg

mars_tree2 <- ladderize(mars_tree)
mars_avg2 <- Mars_Avg[which(Mars_Avg$X %in% mars_tree$tip.label),]
rownames(mars_avg2) <- mars_avg2$X
mars_avg2 <- mars_avg2[match(mars_tree$tip.label, rownames(mars_avg2)),]

```r

impcart <- mice(marsimp3, m = 25, maxit = 20, method = \cart\)
imppmmpvr <- mice(marsimp3, m = 25, maxit = 20, predictorMatrix = predM2)

impnopvrpan <- mice(marsimp2, m = 25, maxit = 20, predictorMatrix = predM1, method = impM5)

impcart.dat <- complete(impcart, action = \long\)

newdata = split(impcart.dat, f = impcart.dat$.imp)
Output = data.frame(Species = sort(edf$Species))
Filename = \Data/MI_Cart/MI_Imp\
variables = colnames(Marsimp)


iter = 1

for (i in newdata) {
  current = i
  current$Species = Species_List
  var_idx = which(colnames(i) %in% variables)
  Output = current[,var_idx]
  newfile = paste(Filename, iter, sep = \_\)
  newfile = paste(newfile, \csv\, sep = \.\)
  write.csv(Output, newfile, row.names = FALSE)
  iter = iter + 1
}

missingfromtree2 = which(!(Marsimp$Species %in% mars_tree$tip.label))
marsimp = Marsimp[-missingfromtree2, ]
marsimp2 = Marsimp[-missingfromtree2,]
marsimp2$Species = as.factor(marsimp2$Species)
marsimp2
library("PVR")
library("plyr")
X <- PVRdecomp(mars_tree, scale = FALSE)

evec <- X@Eigen$vectors

edf <- data.frame(evec)
edf$Species <- mars_tree$tip.label

marsimp3 <- merge(marsimp2, edf, by="Species")

imp0 <- mice(marsimp2, maxit = 0)
Warning: Number of logged events: 3
predM <- imp0$predictorMatrix
impM <- imp0$method
impM[c(3:25, 27:29)] <- "norm"


traits = colnames(Marsimp)[-1]
traits = traits[-1]

predM1 <- predM
predM1[traits, "Species"] <- as.integer(-2)
predM1["Individual", "Species"] <- as.integer(-2)
impM1 <- impM
impM1["Species"] <- c("2lonly.norm")
impM1[c(3:25, 27:29)] <- c("2l.norm")
marsimp2$Species <- as.factor(marsimp2$Species)
Species_List = marsimp3$Species
marsimp2$Species <- sapply(marsimp2$Species, unclass)

predM4 <- predM1
impM4 <- impM1
impM4["Species"] <- c("2lonly.pmm")
impM4[c(3:25, 27:29)] <- c("2l.pmm")

impM5 <- impM1
impM5["Species"] <- c("2lonly.pmm")
impM5[c(3:25, 27:29)] <- c("2l.pan")


impM3 <- impM
impM3[c(3:25, 27:29)] <- c("norm")

imp1 <- mice(marsimp3, maxit = 0)
Warning: Number of logged events: 3
predMpvr <- imp1$predictorMatrix
impMpvr <- imp1$method
impMpvr[c(3:25, 27:29)] <- "norm"


traits = colnames(Marsimp)[-1]
traits = traits[-1]

predM2 <- predMpvr
predM2[traits, "Species"] <- as.integer(-2)
predM2["Species", c(3:25, 27:29, 31:62)] <- as.integer(-2)
predM2["Individual", "Species"] <- as.integer(-2)
impM2 <- impMpvr
impM2["Species"] <- c("2lonly.pmm")
impM2[c(3:25, 27:29)] <- c("2l.pan")
impM2[c(31:62)] <- c("")
marsimp3$Species <- as.factor(marsimp3$Species)
Species_List = marsimp3$Species
marsimp3$Species <- sapply(marsimp3$Species, unclass)
marsimp3$Species <- as.integer(marsimp3$Species)


impcart <- mice(marsimp3, maxit = 20, method = "cart")
